newDashboard.description: Rebuilt dashboard shell, served to a share of signed-in users while the old one stays available.

darkModeDefault.description: Dark mode as the default theme for users who have expressed no preference.

betaFeatures.description: Opt-in surface for unreleased functionality, measured against the control group.

rateLimitRequestsPerMinute.description: Per-client request budget enforced at the edge. Lowered under load, raised once an incident is over.
